title: The in-page Chat box on the Contact page now lets you choose who and which topic
text: The message box in the in-page Chat tab of a Contact page used to write only into the person's own personal chat. It now has the same choices as the Message window, shown above the box: the person's own chat or one of their companies, who it is addressed to (for a company with several members) and the topic. It keeps everything it had: the paperclip for files, the AI polish and suggestions. A plain click on Chat now opens the chat window instead; you see this box with Ctrl or Cmd-click, or on a small screen.
points: Nothing is picked for you when there are several choices, and Enter does not send until you pick one. A closed company is greyed out.
A person with no company still has only their personal chat, already chosen, so writing is as quick as before.
The window says who can see a company message, and warns when the person has no portal login yet.
Files you attach to a company message go into that company's chat.
